title: Create src/commands/loop.ts and wire RocketLoopApp
description: Implement the full loop command handler. Runs preflight checks, reads tasks, selects the backend, then renders the RocketLoopApp TUI via Ink.
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight checks run before TUI is shown
Backend is selected based on CLI flags
tasks, backend, and maxIterations are passed to RocketLoopApp as props

steps.description: Replace stub in src/commands/loop.ts with full implementation
steps.details: Import render from ink. Import RocketLoopApp. Import runPreflight from preflight.ts. Import getBackend from backends/index.ts. Import readTasks from tasks/reader.ts.

export async function loopCommand(options: { claude?: boolean; docker?: boolean; maxIterations: string }): Promise<void> { const agentDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.agent'); const backend = getBackend(options); await runPreflight(agentDir, backend); const tasks = await readTasks(agentDir); const maxIter = parseInt(options.maxIterations, 10) || 10; render(<RocketLoopApp tasks={tasks} backend={backend} maxIterations={maxIter} agentDir={agentDir} />) }
Run `npm run dev -- loop` in a directory with a valid .agent/tasks.json. The TUI should render the task selection screen.

technicalNotes: render() from ink must be called once and returns { unmount, waitUntilExit } — await waitUntilExit() to keep the process alive until the TUI exits
